description: Generated from live routing catalog (one row per tool/skill id). requiresStructuredCorpus is metadata only — never packed into GLiNER labels.

capabilities.label: search
capabilities.whenToUse: Discover an unknown provider operationId from natural language before any execute
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not use when the operationId is already known and arguments are ready

distinguishFrom.reason: search discovers an unknown operationId; execute runs a known one

capabilities.label: execute
capabilities.whenToUse: Run a known operationId with validated arguments
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not guess an operationId; search first when it is unknown

distinguishFrom.reason: execute requires a known operationId; search is for discovery

capabilities.label: memory_recall
capabilities.whenToUse: Retrieve vault or ontology context with schema or title filters
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for exact SQL cohort counts; not for persisting new notes

distinguishFrom.reason: memory_recall is ontology/vault filters; data_query is SQL over the structured corpus
recall reads vault context; ingest writes durable notes

capabilities.label: memory_ingest
capabilities.whenToUse: Persist durable session outcomes to the vault
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for querying cohorts or ephemeral scratch

distinguishFrom.reason: ingest writes; recall reads
ingest is durable vault storage; cache is session-only scratch

capabilities.label: data_query / clawql_sql
capabilities.whenToUse: SQL over the pre-ingested structured corpus for filtered rows or joins
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for vault note recall; not unstructured path hunting

distinguishFrom.reason: data_query is SQL on corpus tables; memory_recall is ontology/vault filters
generic data_query returns rows/joins; cohort_count specializes in exact k of N

capabilities.label: cache
capabilities.whenToUse: Ephemeral session scratch state that need not survive the session
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not durable vault storage; not a compliance trail

distinguishFrom.reason: cache is ephemeral scratch; audit is WORM-linked compliance events
cache does not persist; ingest writes durable vault notes

capabilities.label: audit
capabilities.whenToUse: Append or list WORM-linked audit events for consequential actions
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not ephemeral scratch; not a document search tool

distinguishFrom.reason: audit is durable WORM events; cache is session scratch

capabilities.label: skills_list
capabilities.whenToUse: List skill index entries when the needed skill id is not yet known
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not load every skill body during ranking

distinguishFrom.reason: skills_list is cheap index discovery; skills_get loads one full skill body

capabilities.label: skills_get
capabilities.whenToUse: Load full skill content for a known skill id
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not call until the skill id is selected

distinguishFrom.reason: skills_get needs a known id; skills_list discovers ids

capabilities.label: sandbox_exec
capabilities.whenToUse: Run an isolated code snippet with safe persistence
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for firm-knowledge cohort enumeration or unstructured path hunting as a first tool

distinguishFrom.reason: sandbox_exec is isolated snippet execution; unstructured workspace hunt is dispreferred

capabilities.label: notify
capabilities.whenToUse: Send a one-time Slack milestone or failure notification
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for recurring synthetic checks

distinguishFrom.reason: notify is one-shot messaging; schedule is recurring checks with dry_run

capabilities.label: schedule
capabilities.whenToUse: Create recurring synthetic checks validated with dry_run
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for a single one-shot alert

distinguishFrom.reason: schedule is recurring; notify is one-shot

capabilities.label: ingest_external_knowledge
capabilities.whenToUse: Import external markdown or URL content into knowledge
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for persisting a self-produced session outcome note

distinguishFrom.reason: external ingest imports third-party content; memory_ingest stores session outcomes

capabilities.label: knowledge_search_onyx
capabilities.whenToUse: Search enterprise Onyx-indexed evidence before execution
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not generic public web search; not DuckDB cohort SQL

distinguishFrom.reason: onyx is enterprise-indexed evidence; generic web search is unstructured public search
onyx searches enterprise index; memory_recall targets vault/ontology

capabilities.label: clawql_think
capabilities.whenToUse: Structured reasoning before a consequential decision
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a data retrieval or execute path

capabilities.label: pageindex_build_tree
capabilities.whenToUse: Build a navigable tree index over long-form documents
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for exact SQL cohort counts

distinguishFrom.reason: pageindex structures long-form documents; data_query runs corpus SQL

capabilities.label: ouroboros_run_evolutionary_loop
capabilities.whenToUse: Run a spec-first evolutionary loop with lineage checks
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for isolated snippet execution alone

capabilities.label: bash/grep/find workspace hunt
capabilities.whenToUse: Only when no structured catalog path exists for the task
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Never first choice when SQL, ontology recall, or other catalog tools apply; unstructured workspace hunting lacks cohort N

capabilities.label: generic unstructured search
capabilities.whenToUse: Broad unstructured search without schema filters when no catalog tool fits
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Prefer catalog discovery, enterprise index, or corpus SQL when those apply

distinguishFrom.reason: generic web search is unstructured; mcp.search discovers provider operationIds
generic web search is public/unstructured; onyx is enterprise-indexed

capabilities.label: memory_recall title-flag A
capabilities.whenToUse: Ontology recall filtered by title flag A, excluding flag B
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Wrong when the task asks for title flag B only

distinguishFrom.reason: flag A filter excludes flag B; flag B filter excludes flag A

capabilities.label: memory_recall title-flag B
capabilities.whenToUse: Ontology recall filtered by title flag B, excluding flag A
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Wrong when the task asks for title flag A only

distinguishFrom.reason: flag B filter excludes flag A; flag A filter excludes flag B

capabilities.label: data_query cohort COUNT
capabilities.whenToUse: Exact COUNT over structured flags for k of N denominators
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for coarse topical vault sweeps without a count requirement

distinguishFrom.reason: cohort_count needs exact N; overbroad recall is a coarse topical sweep
cohort_count is the COUNT specialization; data_query is general SQL

capabilities.label: memory_recall overbroad filter
capabilities.whenToUse: Coarse practice-area vault sweep when exact counts are not required
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Wrong when the task needs exact k of N over structured flags

distinguishFrom.reason: overbroad recall is topical and count-agnostic; cohort_count is exact N
